_doc: Empty manifest for scripts/addons/state-restore.mjs (SKILL K28). Fill roots, flow_file_patterns, flows; copy rules and loosen one only with a reason. known_lost items do not fail, they are counted; a restore test replaces its item.

rules.why: typed input kept in screen memory is lost on recreation and process death: rememberSaveable or a store
the flow position kept in screen memory returns the person to the start
an object that owns work, held in remember, dies with the screen: it must belong to a listed flow with a holder outside the screen
in-flight work destroyed when the screen leaves composition: resume by itself or named failure with retry
a stop/resume/new-intent handler that assigns flow state can reset the flow on return
a process singleton holding mutable flow state is lost with the process

_example._comment: One flow entry (not read by the checker). tests values are Class#method found by text search under tests_root; known_lost needs a trigger in background|recreate|process|link.
